title: Pharaoh statues of past and future outside SAIC headquarters

tellings.quote: And Tom Dong when he was, you know, back in like 2017 doing the rounds, he was like, "Oh, you guys, you know, there's this place outside the SIC headquarters where they've got these two statues

plain: A podcast guest, Jay Anderson, told the host Jesse Michels about something the musician Tom DeLonge said around 2017, when he was making the rounds talking about UFOs. According to Anderson, DeLonge said that outside the California headquarters of SAIC, a large US defence contractor, there are two pharaoh statues, one standing for the past and one for the future. The story is told because it would hint that the company sees itself tied to ancient secrets.
